headline: At the Primary 1 level
detail: Almost all use Primary 1 skills: skip counting, number bonds, coins, 2D shapes, centimetres.
evidence: Audit: Core items are "almost all ON-level or consolidation".

headline: Same ideas, new settings, a few previews
detail: Numbers that two counts share (Primary 4), picture graphs where one picture stands for 2 (Primary 2), a letter for a missing number (Primary 6), places past 10th.
evidence: Audit lists these as Primary 2 to 6 ideas in Think harder items (lessons 1 to 4).

headline: Reaches past Primary 1
detail: Growing number patterns, "how many ways" puzzles, comparison problems and logic orderings that the syllabus does not name.
evidence: Audit: Go further items in lessons 1, 2, 4, 5, 8, 9, 10 (and shared multiples again in 10).

headline: At the Primary 2 level, with some early letters
detail: Numbers to 1000, add and subtract, tables of 2 to 10, fractions, money. A few Start here items use a letter for a missing digit.
evidence: Audit: lesson 2 Core uses A and B for digits (a Primary 6 idea); lesson 3 has sharing with leftovers.

headline: Primary 2 ideas, plus previews
detail: Remainders (Primary 3), fraction of a set (Primary 4), finding a start time (Primary 3).
evidence: Audit: Think harder items in lessons 3, 5, 6, 9.

headline: Reaches into Primary 4 to 6
detail: Shared multiples (Primary 4), fraction of a fraction (Primary 5), unknown on both sides of an equation (Primary 6).
evidence: Audit: Go further items in lessons 2, 3, 4, 5, 7.

headline: At the Primary 3 level
detail: Numbers to 10 000, tables of 6 to 9, division with remainders, fractions, area, angles. Letters for digits appear in some items.
evidence: Audit: each lesson main topic is "ON" for Primary 3.

headline: Primary 3 ideas, some Primary 4 previews
detail: Three-term fractions, finding a side from the area or perimeter, shared multiples, heavier two-unknown word problems.
evidence: Audit: Think harder items in lessons 3 to 7. Bar-model problems are "heavier than Primary 3 outcomes imply".

headline: Reaches into Primary 4 and past the syllabus
detail: Shapes with cut-outs (Primary 4), "find a fraction between", last-digit patterns and logic puzzles the syllabus does not name.
evidence: Audit: Go further items in lessons 3, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10.

headline: At the Primary 4 level
detail: Factors, 5-digit numbers, fractions, decimals, protractor angles, area, nets, line graphs. The compass-turn items are not in the 2021 Primary 4 syllabus.
evidence: Audit: all lessons "ON" for Primary 4; compass turns (lesson 6) listed as removed in 2021.

headline: Primary 4 ideas in new settings
detail: Mostly Primary 4 content. A few items use letters as unknowns or divide by a fraction by counting quarters.
evidence: Audit section 3 lists these items by number; it gives no tier-wide verdict.

headline: Some items reach toward Primary 5
detail: Adding fractions with unrelated denominators (probably Primary 5) in four Go further items.
evidence: Audit: Go further 2, 5, 6, 7 in lesson 4; year marked unconfirmed.

headline: At the Primary 5 level
detail: Numbers to 10 million, fractions, triangle area, volume, rate, percentage, angles.
evidence: Audit: all lessons "ON" for Primary 5, with items listed by number.

headline: Primary 5 ideas, one possible preview
detail: Mostly Primary 5. One item is labelled a Primary 6 preview but may already be Primary 5; percentage increase and decrease is probably Primary 6.
evidence: Audit: lesson 2 Think harder 6 and lesson 7 Think harder 1; years marked unconfirmed.

headline: Reaches toward Primary 6
detail: Products of many fractions, percentage change and "find the original".
evidence: Audit: Go further 2 and 7 in lesson 2; 2 to 4 in lesson 7; years marked unconfirmed.

headline: Primary 6 revision plus first steps into Secondary 1
detail: Algebra with a letter and averages are Primary 6. Lessons on sequences, primes and negative numbers are already Secondary 1 topics.
evidence: Audit compares whole lessons with Primary 6 and Secondary 1, not tier by tier.

headline: Evidence is thin
detail: The audit did not separate this tier. Algebra items with brackets and unknowns on both sides are marked secondary school style.

headline: Beyond the primary syllabus
detail: Counting rules, probability, clock arithmetic and codes are not primary topics, and some years could not be confirmed.
evidence: Audit lessons 5, 6, 8 marked "not in syllabus" or "secondary".
